name: CA Foundation (Chartered Accountancy Foundation Examination)
eligibility: You can register for the Foundation Course after passing Class 10, but you can sit the exam only after appearing in the Class 12 board exam (any recognised board). Registration must be done at least four months before the exam month (by 1 Sept for January, 1 Jan for May, 1 May for September). Registration is valid for 4 years from the first eligible attempt. No age limit. Commerce graduates with 55% or other graduates with 60% (and ICSI/ICMAI Intermediate passes) are exempt from Foundation and can go straight to Intermediate.
fee_display: Rs. 9,000/- one-time Foundation Course registration (includes study material); exam fee Rs. 1,500/- per attempt (India centres), late fee Rs. 600/-
forms_out: About 2 months before each exam (e.g. early July for September)
last_date: About 2 months before each exam (e.g. mid/late July for September)
test_date: January, May and September (three times a year)
marking: Papers 3 & 4 (objective): -0.25 per wrong answer; Papers 1 & 2 descriptive
pattern: Four papers of 100 marks each (400 total): Paper 1 Accounting and Paper 2 Business Laws (descriptive, 3 hours each); Paper 3 Quantitative Aptitude (Business Mathematics, Logical Reasoning, Statistics) and Paper 4 Business Economics (objective MCQ on OMR, 2 hours each, 0.25 negative marking). English or Hindi medium.
remarks: Pass needs 40% in each paper and 50% aggregate in one sitting; there is no paper-wise exemption at Foundation. CA is a professional course run by ICAI, not a college degree.
selection_process: Foundation exam (4 papers) → Intermediate (2 groups, 6 papers) → ICITSS (4 weeks) → Articleship / practical training (2 years) → Advanced ICITSS + Self-Paced Online Modules → Final exam (2 groups, 6 papers)
aliases: CA Foundation; ICAI Foundation; Chartered Accountant Foundation; CA entrance

name: CA Inter (Chartered Accountancy Intermediate Examination)
eligibility: Two routes. (1) Foundation route: pass CA Foundation (taken after Class 12), then register for Intermediate. (2) Direct entry route: commerce graduates/post-graduates with at least 55%, other graduates/post-graduates with at least 60%, or those who passed ICSI/ICMAI Intermediate; final-year graduates can register provisionally. Either way you must complete 8 months of study after registering before the exam (register by 1 Jan for September, 1 May of the previous year for January, 1 Sept of the previous year for May). Registration is valid 5 years. No age limit.
fee_display: Rs. 18,000/- one-time Intermediate Course registration (both groups); exam fee Rs. 1,500/- for one group or Rs. 2,700/- for both groups (India centres), late fee Rs. 600/-
forms_out: About 2 months before each exam (e.g. early July for September)

remarks: You can take one group or both groups in a sitting. To pass a group you need 40% in each paper and 50% aggregate; 60% in a paper gives an exemption for the next three attempts. Passing both groups (plus ICITSS) lets you start the 2-year articleship.
